documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sheetal Universal Limited presented its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting operational results, board matters, and corporate governance compliance. The company reported total revenue from operations of Rs. 10,56,747 thousands for FY 2024-25, alongside a net profit after tax of Rs. 93,209 thousands. Management recommended a final dividend of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the agriculture and agro-based industries have demonstrated significant potential for sustained growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The agriculture and agro-based industries, in particular, have demonstrated significant potential for sustained growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the industry remains positive with strong demand projected for domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that as their products are agriculture-based, there is a lot of potential demand for the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

capex_expansion.claim: New machineries were installed to provide better results and cope up with changing industry requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that initiatives are being taken by the company for improving quality standards and reduction of costs.
margins_costs.quote: The initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses were reported at Rs. 1,271,979 thousands for FY 2023-24 compared to Rs. 1,267,295 thousands in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: The operating Expenses of Rs. 1271979 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 1267295 thousands.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.5 per equity share for the year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided to retain the entire amount of profit for FY 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors have pleasure in presenting the 9THAnnual Report along with the audited statements of accounts of your Company for the financial year ended 31st March, 2024.

risks_headwinds.claim: Major fluctuations in the rupee price value corresponding to raw material price fluctuations and stringent market conditions can affect performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Product risk, fluctuation in raw material prices, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Product risk, risk of fluctuation in the raw material price, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company, which requires continuous follow up.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products as a long-term planning strategy.
management_commitments.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
